notes: SNES PLAYER_NAME commands are represented explicitly as Android-style %S(index,0) placeholders for comparison only.
Android anchor intervals include following English-empty localization slots.
Very-high-confidence SNES-to-Android-English identity is not rejected merely because French wording is freely adapted.
When French or Android segmentation crosses individual anchors, preserve and review the complete local sequence block rather than forcing a per-ID translation.

units.source_display: SOLDIER:...
units.android_english_display: Soldier: ...
units.french_display: Soldat : ...
units.note: Exact Soldier ellipsis opens Android 720-728, immediately before accepted 721/722.

units.source_display:
...go up to...next floor.
 When 3 people step onto...
 platform...uh...bridge...
units.android_english_display: When three people step onto...platform...uh...it's...bridge...
units.french_display: Ah, au fait... la dalle, en haut... faut monter à 3 dessus... pour activer le pont...
units.note: Android 728 is the exact three-person platform/bridge instruction and directly follows accepted 727.

units.source_display:
ELINEE:SHRIEK!
 Please forgive me!
units.android_english_display: Elinee: Aaah! Please forgive me!
units.french_display: Elinice : Aaah ! Pardonnez-moi !
units.note: Exact Elinee apology at Android 754 immediately precedes accepted 755-758.

units.source_display:
But I don't have any more
 magical power left.
units.android_english_display: But I don't have that kind of magical power left.
units.french_display: Je suis redevenue une vieille dame ordinaire... je n'ai plus le pouvoir nécessaire.
units.note: Exact lost-magical-power sentence at Android 761 immediately follows accepted 760.

units.source_display: What's this Crystal Orb do?
units.android_english_display: What's this Crystal Orb do?
units.french_display: %S(0,0) : Qu'est-ce que c'est que cet orbe de cristal ?
units.note: Exact Crystal Orb question at Android 973 immediately precedes accepted 974/975; Android adds PLAYER_NAME(0) attribution.

units.source_display: The village is a shambles!
units.android_english_display: The village is in shambles!
units.french_display: Le village est sens dessus dessous !
units.note: Android 1263 is the exact village-in-shambles line between accepted 1262 and 1264.

scenes.label: Amar Sea Hare and belt ordered gaps

units.source_display:
AMAR:It's a Sea Hare's
 tail! Hurrah!
units.android_english_display: Amar: It's a sea hare's tail! Hurrah! Let's throw that in the dry well!
units.french_display: Omar : Oh, mais c'est une queue de lièvre marin ! Vite ! Au puits !
units.note: Android 1642 begins with the exact Sea Hare tail/Hurrah line and adds the well action in the same Amar scene.

units.source_display:
In return let me give you
 this belt!
units.android_english_display: In return, let me give you this belt! It belonged to the legendary knight. I'm sure it'll look great on you!
units.french_display: Prenez ceci en gage de notre gratitude. C'est une ceinture destinée au héros de la légende !
units.note: Android 1664 begins with the exact belt reward and expands its legendary-knight description immediately before accepted 1665.

units.source_display:
What's more, the Fire seed
is gone!
units.android_english_display: What's more, the Fire Seed is gone, and monsters are everywhere!
units.french_display: Et depuis que la Graine qui s'y trouvait a été volée, le désert est infesté de monstres.
units.note: Android 1636 begins with the exact missing Fire Seed sentence and adds the monster consequence directly after accepted 1635.

units.source_display: Ice Country...
units.android_english_display: --Ice Country...
units.french_display: Je me demande si je ne vais pas déménager au Pays de glace, moi aussi.
units.note: Exact Ice Country destination at Android 1623 in the relocation NPC branch.

units.source_display:
I heard there's a town as
warm as this one there!
units.android_english_display: I heard there's a town as warm as this one there!_
units.french_display: Il paraît qu'il y a un village paradisiaque où il fait aussi chaud qu'ici !_ Ça fait rêver !
units.note: Exact warm-town sentence at Android 1624 immediately after 1623; French continuation in the following English-empty slot is retained by anchor interval policy.

units.source_display:
His only equal was the
legendary warrior, Serin.
units.android_english_display: His only equal was the legendary warrior, Serin, who fought in the great war fifteen years ago.
units.french_display: Son seul égal était le chevalier Serynn, son rival et ami, qui combattit pendant la guerre il y a 15 ans.
units.note: Android 2561 begins with the exact Serin legendary-warrior sentence and adds the great-war timing, directly after accepted 2560.

units.source_display: I'm not making it here...
units.android_english_display: I'm not making it here... Maybe I should move to a bigger city...
units.french_display: Cette île est si petite que je n'arrive pas à joindre les deux bouts. Je veux aller en ville !
units.note: Android 2294 begins with the exact 'not making it here' thought and expands the move-to-city idea immediately before accepted 2295.

units.source_display: Eh? You actually WANT one?
units.android_english_display: Eh? You actually WANT one? Well, I was gonna throw it away, anyway...
units.french_display: Hein ? Vous en voulez ? On en a tellement qu'on ne sait plus quoi en faire ! Je vous la donne !
units.note: Android 2296 begins with the exact 'you actually WANT one?' reaction and adds the giveaway rationale between accepted 2295 and 2297.

units.source_display:
ELDER:Leave now and you'll
 never return.
units.android_english_display: Elder: Wait up! If you leave now, you'll never return.
units.french_display: Chef : Attendez ! Si vous descendez, vous n'aurez rien pour remonter !
units.note: Android 500 contains the exact leave-now/never-return warning plus 'Wait up!', immediately before accepted 501.

units.source_display:
You realize we can't
 let you leave...
units.android_english_display: You realize we can't let you leave now that you've found our secret hideout...
units.french_display: Maintenant que vous avez découvert notre repaire, pas question de vous laisser repartir !
units.note: Android 1144 begins with the exact cannot-let-you-leave sentence and adds the secret-hideout reason immediately before accepted 1145.

units.source_display:
BOYS:Hubba, hubba!
BOSS:Do it!!
BOYS:Aye aye, Sir.
units.android_english_display: Boys: Check it out! Boss: Do it!!! Boys: Aye aye, Sir.
units.french_display: Ouah ! Trop classe, la patronne ! Scorpion : Allez, à toi de jouer, Robotor ! Lancez-le, vous autres ! Sbire : À vos ordres, chef !
units.note: The SNES Boys/Boss/Boys reaction is split into ordered Android 1151/1152/1153 directly after accepted 1149/1150.

units.source_display:
These days the Emperor has
such bizarre thoughts...
units.android_english_display: I probably shouldn't be saying this out loud... But these days the emperor has such bizarre thoughts...
units.french_display: Entre vous et moi, je ne comprends pas ce que l'Empereur a derrière la tête, ces temps-ci.
units.note: Android 1871 contains the exact emperor-bizarre-thoughts sentence with a conversational preface, immediately before accepted 1872.

units.source_display:
Go down the mountain a bit,
and you'll see a cave.
Monsters are dwelling.
units.android_english_display: Go down the mountain a bit, and you'll see a cave. There are tons of monsters in there.
units.french_display: Un peu en contrebas de ce village se trouve le Temple des Ténèbres. Il grouille de monstres !
units.note: Android 2315 contains the exact mountain/cave/monsters directions and directly precedes accepted 2316.

units.source_display: JEHK:Hey! Get out of here!
units.android_english_display: Go away!_
units.french_display: Hé ! On n'entre pas !_
units.note: Android 2445 'Go away!' is the same Jehk rejection immediately before accepted 2446/2447; no global short-label matching is used.

units.source_display:
THANATOS:Mwa, ha...is it
 Geshtar, or..?
units.android_english_display: Thanatos: Mwa ha ha... He IS Geshtar...and...he isn't.
units.french_display: Thanatos : Hé hé hé... Ce n'est plus tout à fait le Gestahl que vous avez connu.
units.note: Android 2917 begins with the same Thanatos/Geshtar question-answer and expands it, bracketed by accepted 2915/2916 and 2918/2919.

units.source_display:
Dwarves live in that cave.
 They make good weapons and
 know all about weapons.
 They may know somebody who
 can reforge and empower
 that sword of yours.
units.android_english_display:
Dwarves live in that cave. They make
good weapons and may know somebody who can reforge the Sword.
units.french_display: Là-bas se trouve chez les nains un habile forgeron. Tu vas lui demander de réparer ton épée.
units.note: Android 858 combines the two consecutive SNES dwarf-cave/weapon/reforge fragments between accepted 857 and 859.

units.source_display: VOICE:Helloow!
units.android_english_display: Voice: Hellooo!
units.french_display: Ohééé !
units.note: Exact Voice: Hellooo line at Android 2272 between accepted 2271 and 2273.

units.source_display:
Now, take me to Matango.
 It's to the south-west.
units.android_english_display: Now, take me to Matango. It's to the southwest.
units.french_display: Ah, et j'aimerais que vous me rameniez à Matango ! C'est au sud-ouest d'ici.
units.note: Exact Matango/southwest instruction at Android 2280 immediately after accepted 2279.

units.source_display: Got Gnome's powers!
units.android_english_display: Gained Gnome's powers!
units.french_display: Vous obtenez les pouvoirs de Gnome !
units.note: Android 1048 'Gained Gnome's powers!' is the exact system-message equivalent immediately before accepted 1049.

units.source_display: Got Salamando's powers!
units.android_english_display: Gained Salamando's powers!
units.french_display: Vous obtenez les pouvoirs d'Athanor !
units.note: Android 1807 'Gained Salamando's powers!' is the exact system-message equivalent immediately after accepted 1806.

units.source_display:
So sad this place has
 grown...but enough! Take with you my powers!
 GO! Mana is fading...
units.android_english_display: Hurry! Take my powers! Mana is fading from this world faster than ever!
units.french_display: Je vais vous octroyer mon pouvoir. La force de Mana disparaît partout dans le monde. Ne perdez pas un instant !
units.note: Android 2649 compresses the two consecutive SNES Luna fragments into the same take-my-powers / Mana-is-fading message between accepted 2648 and 2651.

units.source_display:
LUMINA:I'm Lumina!
 The king was robbing me of
 my power!
 He was forcing me to make
 gold! My power should not
 be used by anyone but you!
units.android_english_display:
Lumina: I'm Lumina, the light elemental!
The king was robbing me of my power!
He was forcing me to make gold!
units.french_display: Lumina : Je me nomme Lumina. Le roi de cette île se servait de ma magie pour fabriquer de l'or. Mais tout cela est fini, maintenant. Et un jour, cette île redeviendra pierre.
units.note: Android 2533 combines the two consecutive SNES Lumina introduction / king draining power / making gold fragments immediately before accepted 2536/2538.
